name: Simplified Chinese Profile
description: Language profile for Simplified Chinese literary and narrative texts.

chapter_rules.pattern: ^\s*第[0-9一二三四五六七八九十百千万]+[章回节卷部集篇]\s*.*$
chapter_rules.description: Matches standard numbered Chinese chapter headings such as 第1章 or 第二回

chapter_rules.pattern: ^\s*(序章|前言|引子|序言|楔子|尾声|后记|附录|终章)\s*.*$
chapter_rules.description: Matches introductory and concluding book section titles
